title: The Punisher
evidence: Original XD prototype: partner invitation, rock-paper-scissors role selection, demands, timed task contracts, completion approval and outcomes.
interpretation: Sculptural Angel and softened Devil reviewing a shared task contract. Tasks and approval derive from the original prototype; styling, task props and polished phone layout are illustrative concept design.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Rework this supplied single cohesive artwork for "The Punisher" using newly recovered original app prototype context. Keep the premium realistic carved-marble art direction, warm cinematic lighting, refined cream/gold/burgundy palette, single wide oval dark marble platform, and gentle adult Angel and Devil characters. Especially preserve the toned-down male: human face, friendly playful expression, warm ivory skin in marble, tiny horns partly hidden in hair, small discreet tail, burgundy draped clothes. Do NOT revert to a scary red demon or cartoon. Angel retains finely sculpted feather wings and slim brass halo. Keep the entire scene visible in a landscape 3:2 image.
NEW STORY: this is a playful partner challenge and negotiated task contract, not simply a romantic date. They connect, play rock-paper-scissors for first choice of role, negotiate everyday tasks and consequences, set a time limit, and request partner approval when done.
Recompose their inward-facing arms so they are actively reviewing a shared ivory contract folio on the bench just behind the phone: angel holds a slender brass pen pointed toward the agreement; the friendly devil gestures open-handed toward the same agreement as if negotiating. Their expressions remain affectionate and lightly mischievous, with natural adult proportions and exceptionally realistic sculpted hands. Remove the gold heart between their fingertips. No raised threatening gestures.
The central upright smartphone is the focal point, slightly larger and beautifully legible. Its cream, burgundy and brass interface contains ONLY the following exact readable text, organized as an elegant uncluttered mobile app:
"The Punisher"
"OUR CONTRACT"
"Angel & Devil"
"1 WEEK" and "2 days left" as small status chips on the same line
"Buy groceries" with a completed checkbox
"Tidy the room" with an empty checkbox
"No sweet drinks" with an empty checkbox
a burgundy button reading "Approve Me"
No other interface text. These are illustrative polished renderings of recovered prototype features, not an exact copy of the old UI.
Replace the foreground gift box with a finely crafted small woven grocery basket holding bread, leafy greens and fruit, representing the original grocery task. Replace the foreground dish pile with a small elegant cleaning bucket, folded cloth and a wooden-handled brush, representing household tasks and consequences. Keep these props smaller than the phone and figures.
At the front center, between the two props, place exactly THREE small ivory-and-burgundy game tokens with beautifully engraved brass hand symbols: a closed fist for ROCK, an open palm for PAPER, and a two-finger V for SCISSORS. They are subtle game pieces resting directly on the same base, not another scene or screen. A small brass hourglass beside the contract reinforces the time limit. Thin brass inlays connect the tokens, phone and task props, making a single coherent flow rather than a diagram. No floating labels, no split panels, no giant arrows or neon trails. Front-edge inscription "The Punisher" retained.
High-end photographed museum sculpture, rich contact shadows, realistic marble veins, textured feathers, tactile basket weave, cloth fibres, polished bronze and glass. Cohesive composition, physically plausible supports, warm gallery key lighting and restrained cool rim. Focus on two partners agreeing on a game-like contract. Avoid excessive extra props and visual clutter. No cartoon proportions, no skulls, no weapons, no flames.

initialArtwork.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape 3:2 hero artwork for The Punisher, a playful couples accountability app, intended to become an animated 3D miniature later.
Primary request: a beautifully crafted angel-and-devil diorama that clearly tells the story of partners setting a shared task and following through with a reward or a playful consequence. The angel and devil are the central personalities, not tiny background icons.
Composition: elevated three-quarter view of one cohesive theatrical miniature on a broad oval ivory stone plinth. A charming adult angel on the left and adult devil on the right lean toward a central upright smartphone, negotiating a task together. Both figures equally prominent, expressive and finely sculpted with believable adult proportions, detailed hands and faces, elegant tailored clothing. Angel: warm ivory clothing, layered feathered wings and thin floating brass halo. Devil: burgundy tailored clothes, small curved horns and a graceful pointed tail, mischievous and friendly expression. No weapons. A continuous brass heart-shaped arc behind the phone links both figures.
The central phone has a crisp cream interface with the exact title "The Punisher", a small label "OUR AGREEMENT", and a prominent task card reading "Plan our date". Below it show two beautifully simple outcome cards: a gold gift icon labelled "Reward", and a burgundy dish-and-sponge icon labelled "Consequence". Make the interface clean, readable, minimal, not a dense dashboard. Physical miniatures echo the outcomes at the front: a small elegantly wrapped gold present near the angel and a neat stack of porcelain dishes with a sponge near the devil. Thin inset gold paths branch from the central task toward these two outcome objects; small heart and checkmark details communicate mutual agreement, not combat. Front plinth plaque reads "The Punisher".
Style: premium collectible sculptural diorama photographed with a macro lens, cinematic but tactile and coherent. Finely carved ivory faces and hands, softly textured woven clothes, individually layered wing feathers, polished brass, satin burgundy enamel, subtle stone pores, realistic contact shadows and ambient occlusion. Detailed character sculpting, not basic cylinders or toy blocks. Warm ivory and gold against deep wine-red with a restrained midnight-blue studio background. Soft warm key light from left, cool rim light from right, inviting glow around halo and outcome paths. Rich shadow depth, controlled highlights, entire diorama in focus, no cropping of wings or base. The physical objects have clear silhouettes suitable for later 3D reconstruction. No extra people, no angel-versus-devil battle, no threats, no flames, no Marvel skull symbol, no unrelated branding. This is a concept representation, not a screenshot of a shipped app. Image only, no explanatory captions outside the scene.
initialArtwork.interpretation: Plan our date, gift, dishes and sponge are illustrative examples. Character styling and phone interface are concept design, not recovered original UI.
